name: TopBar
purpose: The fixed-height chrome bar at the top of a page — search, quick actions, and the current user, always in the same place.
neverUseFor: The page title — use PageHeader inside the main content area instead
Primary navigation — use SideNav; TopBar hosts secondary/global actions, not the nav itself
Scrollable content — TopBar is fixed chrome, never part of the scrolling main area

anatomy.description: Root — always a native <header>, fixed height.
Leading slot — typically a search Input.
Trailing slot — typically icon Buttons and an Avatar.

height.note: Past ADR-004's Control scale top rung (xl=48px) — aliases the next primitive rung up (primitive.size.350), documented in component-token-exceptions.md.

a11y.role: banner (implicit from <header>, when it's a direct child of <body> in the real page — not automatic inside Storybook's iframe)
